name: db-agent
description: DB Schema Agent — generates EF Core entity classes, Fluent API configurations, and PostgreSQL migrations for AdventureWorks database evolution

postToolUse.command: echo '🔍 File written — running round-trip migration test...' && cd demo && dotnet ef database update --project src/AdventureWorks.Infrastructure/AdventureWorks.Infrastructure.csproj --startup-project src/AdventureWorks.Api/AdventureWorks.Api.csproj 2>&1 | tail -5
